remarks: Prime Sono 1 Bedroom Condo for rent with assigned parking! Move right in to this turn key, pristine, fully renovated first floor loft condo with open floor plan. Featuring vaulted ceilings, exposed brick, hardwood floors, and oversized windows with great natural light. Beautiful center kitchen island, stainless steel lux appliances, and granite countertops. Spacious primary bedroom with large walk in closet. Chic full bath and full size in-unit washer and dryer. Plenty of closets and extra storage space. Additional parking spots available for guests. Assigned Parking #10 for Tenant. Enjoy desirable South Norwalk shopping, SONO Collection, restaurants on the lively Washington Street, minutes from Cafe Pasture Beach and easy access to Metro North Train station.
